rule: A build reaches live only through staging: verify-deploy staging green at the same commit
A live deploy waits while a study session or skills run is going on live (an explicit --during-session on Matt's OK overrides)

A live deploy needs Matt's explicit OK: his words in the chat (--matt-ok), or his Ship it tap on the page (D-198): a ship job naming the build's commit, written by his page, with no result yet and under 24 hours old (--from-job <id>)
